# Curezy

> AI Care Operating System for Clinics & Autonomous Healthcare Workflows.

Curezy automates clinic operations, patient follow-ups, medication adherence tracking, and engagement over WhatsApp & AI Voice. Built with HIPAA and DPDP compliance.

## Key Information & Links

- [Overview & Agent Specs](https://www.curezy.in/agent.md): Technical and operational overview of Curezy AI Care OS, WhatsApp native care workflows, and outbound voice agents.
- [Pricing & Plans](https://www.curezy.in/pricing): Clinic automation tiers, provider seats, and AI voice minutes.
- [About Curezy](https://www.curezy.in/about-us): Mission, leadership, and company background.
- [Android App](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.curezy.app): Curezy patient health companion app.

## Capabilities for Clinics
- **WhatsApp Native Care OS:** Automated appointment reminders, triage, medication adherence loops, and follow-ups without requiring app downloads.
- **AI Voice Agents:** Medically-grounded voice calling to recover lost appointments, follow up post-consultation, and collect feedback.
- **EMR Integration:** Bi-directional sync with clinic management systems and electronic medical records.
